name: io.github.w0lph/dog-geroscience-mcp
title: Dog Geroscience
description: Dog-specific aging tools: HAGR dog rows, dog orthologs, dose translation, DAP codebooks, FDA FOI.

environmentVariables.name: DOG_GERO_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the prebuilt SQLite database (about 90 MB, downloaded from the Hugging Face Hub on first run). Default: a per-user cache directory.

environmentVariables.name: DOG_GERO_DB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Alternative download URL for the prebuilt database (a mirror, or a build of your own).
